digestRules.grantHash: keccak256(abi.encode(LAUNCH_GRANT_TYPEHASH, bindingAHash, bindingBHash, reviewHash)); grantHash and grantDigest are excluded from their own preimage
digestRules.receiptCoreHash: codec normalizes receiptCoreHash to zero before hashing
digestRules.finalityIndexingReceiptHash: codec normalizes finalityIndexingReceiptHash to zero before hashing

grantAndCurrentness.activation: purpose-bound reviewer ERC-1271 attestation over the exact EIP-712 grant digest
grantAndCurrentness.consumption: atomic Active to Consumed only after typed graph validation and reservation; a revert rolls back consumption
grantAndCurrentness.currentness: separate reviewer ERC-1271 transport bound to chain, registry, wallet, grant digest, plan, request, result, intent, current security-control head and security/policy epochs; valid window is at most 3600 seconds
grantAndCurrentness.revocation: reviewer or governance may revoke either an Active grant or a currentness digest; a security/policy epoch advance invalidates stale currentness without expiring the evergreen grant

requiredPerComponent: exact account and non-empty observed runtime code hash
configuration hash and source-bound creation evidence hash
canonical Create nonce or Create2 deployer/salt/init-code hash provenance, or an ExternalCanonical ID
strictly ordered components and edges plus directed connectivity from component zero
typedProvenance.poolBinding: a pool requires a complete nonzero PoolManager, runtime hash, ExternalCanonical component index, pool ID, pool key hash and pool result hash
typedProvenance.applicationBinding: applicationHash must equal the exact Application component account/runtime/configuration commitment

receiptAndFinality.identity: finality/indexing entries bind the immutable receipt core hash and grant digest and cannot rewrite launch identity

executionReadiness.sourceTimeConstraint: ExternalExecutionTimeBound may only record nonzero evidence; it has no execute route in this package
executionReadiness.newSourceAnchor: requires a distinct completed-graph plan, review, LaunchGrant and currentness; it must never be JIT-mutated under an existing grant

reason: This source-neutral package contains no Hookemon profile ID, deployment address, runtime hash, source revision, manifest, policy, evidence or activation.
A source-specific schedule anchor or execution deadline is evidence only here; it never creates an execution bypass.

requiredBeforeAnyAdoption: an explicit new reviewed COMPLETED_GRAPH_ADOPTION route/schema/profile rebind
a new exact plan with typed component graph, provenance, runtime/configuration, source and deployment evidence
a distinct purpose-bound LaunchGrant and fresh currentness

forbiddenSurface: value, fund, transfer, approve or allowance execution
securityBoundary.allowedBytes: only the bounded reviewer ERC-1271 currentness signature
fixedExternalCalls: bounded-return-data ERC-1271 staticcall to the codehash-pinned reviewer authority

manualSurfaceReview.result: no executable CREATE, CREATE2, delegatecall, applicant-selected target, selector, opaque action bytes, value or token approval surface
manualSurfaceReview.fixedCalls: only codehash-pinned Codec/Validator methods and a bounded 32-byte ERC-1271 staticcall

coverage: active grant becomes consumed and anchors receipt
revoked currentness does not consume an active grant
revoked grant cannot consume even with otherwise-valid currentness
winner-key reservation rejects a competing grant
years-later fresh currentness works for an active evergreen grant
epoch advance blocks stale currentness without revoking the evergreen grant
source-time evidence is required and cannot make an execute route
legacy custom-graph route mutation cannot silently consume the existing grant
published typehash formula values remain stable
